gem_guidance.text: Netherblade Facemask is the first of two pieces of the Netherblade Tier set that you'll want to be using on your Rogue for your Phase 1 best-in-slot gear set. The helmets without meta gem sockets are noticeably worse due to the powerful Relentless Earthstorm Diamond that can be used.
